description: Schema for agent session entities that track conversational state and runtime context. When a session is resumed, MCP-server tool resources are re-resolved against the resuming executor's machine/user context (the search prefixes machine profile, '${USER}/mcp-servers', then 'defaults/mcp-servers'), so the same session may bind to a different mcp-server entity on a different machine.

agent-session-id.description: Agent session identifier used by IAgentPersistenceStore.

host-profile-entity-id.description: Entity ID of the user-computer-profile hosting this agent session.

agent-definition-reference.description: Reference to the agent-manifest or agent-definition this session runs, used to reconstruct the definition when the session is resumed. Accepts either an entity-name (array of strings) or an entity-id (uuid string).

parent-agent-session-ids.description: Entity references to the parent agent sessions of this session. Set on sub-agent sessions to reference the dispatcher's own agent-session entity, so sub-agents are excluded from the top-level sessions view. When absent or empty, the session is a top-level session.

sub-agent-description.description: Human-readable description of a sub-agent session, persisted by the sub-agent dispatcher so the dispatcher can reconstruct its in-memory sub-agent list after a restart.

parameter-values.description: Parameter values supplied when this session was created. Keyed by parameter name; all values are strings. The well-known key `working-directory` (kind: string) sets the working directory forwarded to the agent process; supported by the `github-copilot` and `workspaces` manifests.

parameter-selections.description: NEW (#1434/#1437, per-component-executor-binding, M7). Typed launch-parameter selections keyed by parameter name; each value is a structured JSON selection object (e.g. an `executor` parameter records `{"trust-profile":"<name-or-id>"}` or `{"user-computer-profile":"<entity-id>"}`). This is a sibling of the `string->string` `parameter-values` text-templating map; the executor selection is NOT stored as a JSON-encoded string in `parameter-values`, which stays string-only.

executor-bindings.description: NEW (#1437, per-component-executor-binding). The resolved executors for this session, so the topology reconstructs on resume. Every value is a transport connection-descriptor object (the same type-discriminated JSON consumed by ITransportFactory.ConnectToAsync: `local`, `user-computer-profile`, `http`, `reverse-http`, ...) - there is NO parallel executor schema. Back-compat (on read): if `session` is absent but `host-profile-entity-id` is present, the session executor is derived as `{"type":"user-computer-profile","entity-id":<that id>}`.

session.description: The explicit overall session executor connection-descriptor (default `{"type":"local"}`); per-component executors override it.

components.description: Per-executor map of executor name -> resolved connection-descriptor object (never a bare client-instance string).

auto-resume.description: When present, the identified trusted executor will automatically resume this agent session on startup, sending the configured resume prompt as the opening message.

trusted-executor.description: Identifier of the trusted executor that should resume this session. Use '.' for the local executor, or a UUID string for a remote executor identified by its user-computer-profile entity-id.

resume-prompt.description: Prompt sent to the agent when it is auto-resumed. When absent, a default prompt is used.
